title: Mixed Event — Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back — Episode2 The Core of the Band

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back
meta.Episode: Episode2 — The Core of the Band
meta.Event Outline: It's almost time for the Miya Girls choir recital. Honami is selected as the coordinator for her class, but it's hard to coordinate when everyone's opinions are split right down the middle! What is kindness? Stuck between a rock and a hard place, Honami gives her answer...!

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: MEIKO's here... But how?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We never saw her here before...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Everyone's here...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Were you looking for us by any chance?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Miku! Luka!
Where were you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sorry about worrying you. MEIKO showed up, so we were giving her a tour of the place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then we sensed that you'd all come and brought her here to surprise you, but we must've passed each other along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: MEIKO just showing up when she was never around before... What does this mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's probably connected to everyone's true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our true feelings? Of always wanting to be together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're here in SEKAI to help you find those feelings, but I suppose things are a little bit different in my case.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure that I'm here because you all managed to move forward after finding your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I'm just guessing though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In any case, I'm here and hope you won't mind me sticking around.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Of course not! It'd be great to have you with us...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As usual, I don't get this place...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait. Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO's joining us for our practice sessions from now on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're Ichika, you're Saki and Shiho... And Honami, right? I'm looking forward to playing with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is such a pleasant surprise...
I can't believe I'm actually talking to MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're happy to have you with us, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, now that you've met everyone, why don't we play something together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good idea. I was just about to suggest the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... We heard someone playing the drums just now, so does that mean you're a drummer, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I play a few other instruments too.
You're the drummer of the band, right, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes! If you don't mind, could I ask you for some tips later?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! I'm always happy to help!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku...
Before that, I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before we all start playing together, would it be okay if we watched the three of you play first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm just kind of curious, that's all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. I'd like to see how the three of you play together as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If that's the case, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about me on guitar, Luka on bass and MEIKO on drums?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay with me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's begin!
One, two, three, four!
song00003_off_f

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't this... Our song?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is amazing! This doesn't sound like the Miku and Luka we usually hear...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it sounds so much cooler than when we play!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's completely different. It's better than when Miku and Luka are alone, or when we play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think it's because of MEIKO's drumming.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The drum is the foundation that supports the band. It has the power to draw out the entire band's potential.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks to MEIKO's drumming, Miku and Luka are able to go all out and play to their heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The foundation that supports the band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (MEIKO's so cool. She looks so strong and confident...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder if I'll ever be able to play like that one day?)
